requirements.requirement: The system must successfully fetch CMS Part D dataset files from a configured source endpoint using data_fetcher_base.py without manual intervention.
The system must validate that fetched files are non-empty and match expected file format (e.g., CSV or TSV) before processing.
The system must parse raw CMS Part D files into structured records with all required fields present (e.g., prescriber identifier, drug name, claim counts).
The system must map each prescriber record to a valid NPI value when an NPI field is present in the dataset.
The system must discard or flag records where NPI is missing or invalid according to numeric format rules.
The system must map drug identifiers or names to a condition taxonomy using icd10_loader.py.
The system must assign at least one ICD10-based condition category to each successfully mapped drug.
The system must normalize numeric metrics (e.g., claim counts, beneficiary counts) into consistent numeric types.
The system must standardize drug names to a canonical format (e.g., uppercase, trimmed whitespace).
The system must output transformed records in a structure compatible with the schema defined in PIPE-RX-INGEST-S1.
The system must batch transformed records into discrete payloads ready for downstream persistence.
The system must log ingestion progress including number of files processed and number of records parsed.
The system must log and surface errors encountered during parsing or transformation without terminating the entire pipeline.
The system must handle the exception where the CMS data source is unreachable by retrying at least once before failing the job.
The system must handle the exception where ICD10 mapping fails for a drug by assigning a default 'unmapped' condition category.
The system must use Azure Function orchestration defined in function_app.py to execute the ingestion pipeline.
The system must ensure that each ingestion run is idempotent at the transformation stage (no duplicate transformed records within a single run).
The system must ensure that parsing logic supports large file sizes without exceeding Azure Function execution limits.
The system must produce deterministic transformation output given the same input dataset.
The system must validate that required fields (NPI, drug name, claim count) are present before including a record in output.
